title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: tiling
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Apartment floor and wall tiling
swms.task: Lay floor and wall tiles in the apartment bathrooms and kitchens, cutting porcelain tiles with wet saws, and mixing adhesive and grout.

facts.silicaControls: Tiles are cut with a water-fed wet saw, with no dry cutting. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn by anyone still at risk. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the tile adhesive, grout and sealer are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves and eye protection.

steps: Mix and apply adhesives, grouts, screeds and sealers

swms.title: Balcony and terrace tiling
swms.task: Lay tiles on the apartment balconies and podium terraces next to the edge, cutting tiles with grinders and mixing screed and adhesive.

facts.silicaControls: Tiles are cut with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while cutting. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the screed, adhesive and grout are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves and eye protection.
facts.fallControl: Balcony balustrades or temporary edge protection stay in place, and no one works outside them.

steps: Mix and apply adhesives, grouts, screeds and sealers
Tile balconies and terraces near edges

swms.title: Lobby stone and tile floors
swms.task: Lay natural stone and porcelain tiles on the ground floor lobby with epoxy grout, cutting the stone with wet saws.

facts.silicaControls: Stone and tiles are cut with a water-fed wet saw. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while cutting. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the epoxy grout and adhesive are kept at the work area: skin sensitiser, wear chemical resistant gloves and eye protection.

steps: Mix and apply adhesives, grouts, screeds and sealers

rules.phrase: Ceramic and porcelain tiles and grout are not engineered stone
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 529A, s 529D
rules.quote: does not include ... ceramic wall or floor tiles

rules.phrase: Kneeling while laying tiles is a hazardous manual task
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 60
rules.quote: kneeling while trowelling concrete or laying carpet
